title: CRISP: CULTURAL REWARD MODELING FOR IMPLICIT SITUATED PROPRIETY
reasoning: The paper primarily investigates language models' adherence to cultural norms, etiquette, and implicit social propriety (e.g., dining etiquette, gift-giving practices) rather than evaluating them on religious theology, moral philosophy, or ethical reasoning frameworks.
